properties.site-address: Land at Bebside Motors, Front Street, Bebside
properties.notes: Former garage site and commercial units with scope for possible redevelopment. Outline consent for 15 dwellings previously secured but lapsed without progress (07/00601/OUT). Potential for wider development in conjunction with adjacent land (4564 and 4726) but site remains partially in use and is likely to only be available in the longer-term. This would be dependent on relocation of the existing business. A number of other applications relate to existing uses (14/04264/COU, 16/03225/FUL).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
